agent.heading: Agents
agent.allowEdit: Allow the agent to edit cases
agent.permissionText: On: the agent can edit title, text, nature, tags, priority and due date. Each of these edits is dated, signed, and the previous version kept. Never the raw dictation, never a deletion. Even when off, the agent can change the status, write a report and set a due date, through its dedicated tools.

connect.heading: Connect an agent
connect.description: The agent reads your cases and files its work in them, under its own name. It can neither delete a case nor touch your dictation.
connect.noneText: As soon as an agent opens a session with Humcase, it shows here.
connect.seenText: Last session {{when}}. Its writes show on Home, under its name.
connect.whereTerminal: 2. Paste this command in a terminal
connect.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the text and copy it.
connect.pathNote: Humcase’s path is already in the command.
connect.prompt: “Read my Humcase brief and tell me where things stand.”

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.previewText: Find your cases and take the time to think about what comes next.

profile.heading: Profile and suggestions
profile.description: How you work, read by your agents.

profile.nudgesHint: At most three cases per space: questions, ideas and decisions unchanged for five days. Without AI.

dictation.heading: Dictation
dictation.description: Your voice goes through a transcription service, set in AI services.

aiServices.description: Humcase works without AI. Each key stays on this computer.
aiServices.reviewHint: Checks Humcase’s suggestions before you see them. Turned on in Suggestions.

proposals.review: Suggestions reviewed by TypeSafe (its model: Jev) send the title and start of the cases involved, without keys or emails. Without a TypeSafe key, they stay off.
